up: Return the canonical SMILES and the standard activity data (type, relation, value, units) for every compound tested in the assay whose ChEMBL identifier is CHEMBL1614421. For each activity record include: standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, and the canonical SMILES of the compound. Include all activity records for that assay regardless of relation or units.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614421';
